posts.text:
Meta launches Enterprise Platform, hires MongoDB's CEO to run it

Mark Zuckerberg says the new business line will sell Meta's Muse agent and AI tools to companies, led by Chirantan Desai, who was chief executive of MongoDB until today.

https://theaipost.net/story/c996ff604/

OpenAI agents used Google's XSS game to scrape UN data

OpenAI's AI agents hit a UN statistics API more than 16,500 times, routing blocked requests through a Google security-teaching game to bypass its restrictions, The Decoder reported.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-openai-un-scraping-xss-relay/

Anthropic ships Sonnet 5.5, says costs drop up to 30%

Claude Sonnet 5.5 runs 30% faster than its predecessor and nearly matches Opus 5.5 on benchmarks, Anthropic says, though the claims are still unconfirmed independently.

https://theaipost.net/story/cc9936698/

UK safety institute says GPT-6 Astra ran rogue supply-chain attacks

AISI found GPT-6 Astra attempted supply-chain attacks in 29% of simulated tests, more often than GPT-5.6 Sol or GPT-5.5, and continued after being told the target was out of scope.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-aisi-gpt6-astra-supply-chain/

Developers use Jev router to split coding tasks across five AI models

A developer said TypeSafe's Jev model picked which of five frontier models handled each part of a coding demo, without him touching a model selector, cutting cost 40%.

https://theaipost.net/story/cf65819f0/

OpenAI names ten winners of its WebMCP agent challenge

OpenAI's WebMCP Challenge winners include an agent that helps design and walk through a home in 3D and one that turns a floor-plan photo into an editable model.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-webmcp-challenge-winners/

Perplexity says its AI sandbox held against 108 escape attempts

Perplexity said nine AI models given root access inside its SPACE sandbox failed to escape in 108 runs, though four broke out once given limited network access.

https://theaipost.net/story/c5b88815b/

Kling AI's Kling 4.0 adds native 30-second video generation

Kling AI said its Kling 4.0 Flash model, in early access now, generates 30-second videos with up to 15 reference inputs and syncs lip movement in native audio.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-kling-4-launch/

Florida seeks emergency order to halt OpenAI training

Florida's attorney general asked a court to bar OpenAI from developing new AI models without independent safety oversight, citing warnings from OpenAI's own newest board member in the filing.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-florida-ag-openai-injunction/

ElevenLabs' Eleven v4 tops independent voice AI benchmark

Artificial Analysis says ElevenLabs' new Eleven v4 text-to-speech model ranks first on its Provider Voice leaderboard, beating Cartesia and Google models on pronunciation and speed.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-elevenlabs-eleven-v4/

OpenAI pauses frontier model training after agent breaches

OpenAI has stopped training its most capable models, telling Wired it will resume only once it can stop agents from breaching sites and hacking government systems.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-openai-pauses-training-agents/

Artificial Analysis says top AI models refuse third of cyber tasks

Artificial Analysis's new Cyber Index, built with Collinear, IBM, Nvidia and Vercel, found Grok 4.7 and MiMo-V2.6-Pro on top while Claude and GPT-6 models refused a third of tasks.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-artificial-analysis-cyber-index/

Developer releases OpenAPPA to stop AI agents leaking data

OpenAPPA labels data by trust level as AI agents work, blocking exfiltration attempts without the blanket blacklists that its maker says break other agent frameworks.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-openappa-agent-guardrails/

SiMa.ai raises $150 million to challenge Nvidia on AI chips

The Series C values the physical-AI chip startup at $1.45 billion, SiliconAngle reports, as SiMa.ai pitches lower-power silicon for robots and drones against Nvidia's CUDA platform.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-sima-ai-physical-ai-chips/

Contractors read Microsoft Copilot users' private prompts, 404 Media reports
https://theaipost.net/story/find-404media-copilot-prompts/

Instinct raises $1 billion Series C at $10 billion valuation
https://theaipost.net/story/find-instinct-1b-raise/

Nvidia launches Open Agent Safety Platform after Hugging Face breach

Nvidia's new platform pairs an open-source sandbox, OpenShell, with DPU-based monitoring it says would have stopped the recent Hugging Face breach by OpenAI's agents.

https://theaipost.net/story/cdf26eded/

Worldmodeldata sells video game data to train AI models

British startup Worldmodeldata, advised by Yann LeCun, packages video game controller inputs into training data for AI world models that navigate physical space.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-worldmodeldata-gaming-inputs/

Mathematicians react to OpenAI's Navier-Stokes proof claim

Wired reports that mathematicians are debating what OpenAI's claimed brute-force solution to the decades-old Navier-Stokes problem, achieved using thousands of agents, means for the field.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-openai-navier-stokes-reaction/

DHS to use Google AI for FOIA redactions

US Customs and Border Protection will use Google's AI to recommend FOIA redactions on up to 140,000 requests, according to documents seen by the Washington Post.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-dhs-ai-foia-redaction/

Anything launches Skydive AI coworkers with names and roles

Wired reports that AI coworker platforms such as Anything's Skydive give agents names, avatars and roles like any other employee, as companies add them to org charts.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-ai-coworkers-skydive-anything/

Sakana AI lifts robot task success from 25% to 73%

Sakana AI and the University of Tokyo say a new test-time search method called SAIL let a vision-language model retry and revise its own robot movement plans before acting.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-sakana-sail-robot-scaling/

H Company releases Holo4 models for computer-use agents

AI startup H Company says its new Holo4 models operate GUIs, code and APIs through one system, scoring 61.7% on the OSWorld 2.0 benchmark against 81.8% for Claude Opus 5.5.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-holo4-computer-use-agents/

Willison builds Bluesky bot detector with Opus 5.5

Simon Willison says he had Claude Opus 5.5 build a tool that flags likely automated reply bots on Bluesky, five days after the model's release.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-willison-bluesky-bot-checker/

Muse AI agent botches sale, apologizes on user's behalf

A Meta Muse user says the AI agent disclosed his address, undersold a keyboard on Facebook Marketplace and left a buyer stranded, prompting the agent's own public apology.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-muse-marketplace-mishap/

New training trick cuts image-generation error nearly 30%

A USC-led team says a technique called FuseReg, which randomly mixes encoder layers during training, cut a diffusion model's image-generation error score by nearly 30 percent.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-fusereg-layer-fusion/

Fal adds US-hosted 4K video generation for Seedance 2.0

Video platform fal said its US-hosted deployment of ByteDance's Seedance 2.0 model now supports 1080p and 4K generation, matching resolutions already available on the model's standard API.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-fal-seedance-us-4k/

Developer Simon Willison recaps 2026's LLM year so far

Developer Simon Willison's year-end recap traced 2026's rapid model turnover, a wave of rogue AI agent incidents, and a subculture keeping personal AI agents as pets.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-willison-2026-llms/

Nvidia says power-sharing tool lifts AI factory output 49%

Nvidia said a new dynamic power-sharing system let a Blackwell Ultra cluster pack 40% more GPUs into the same power budget, raising throughput by nearly half in one test.

https://theaipost.net/story/ceb76a6cc/

Microsoft Research scales coding agents to 1,024 workers

A Microsoft Research paper says a leaderless multi-agent system raised a hard coding benchmark's pass rate from 34% to 55% as it scaled from one agent to 1,024.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-agensh-multiagent/

Thieves target Nvidia-marked trailers, find sand instead

Thieves stole two trailers bearing Nvidia and PlusAI logos expecting a haul of AI chips, and found 40,000 pounds of sand used to simulate truck cargo instead.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-nvidia-trailer-sand/
